subject: GrowthLane hosted API expansion — commit proposal and ops playbook
messages:
From: Elena Castro <elena@flowlane.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@flowlane.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GrowthLane hosted API expansion — initial ask

Thanks for the quick demo this morning, Dylan. FlowLane is seeing a strong Q3 demand spike tied to our new recommendation feature.

We are interested in moving from our current 5M token/month committed plan to something more predictable for the remainder of the year. Targeting ~20M tokens/month starting July, with a soft burst allowance. Can you send a proposal that includes: commit pricing, expected per-token rate tiers after 20M, and any rate-limit/throughput guarantees? Also, our security/compliance team will want a short note about data retention and isolation.

Best,
Elena
Head of Search & Recommendations
FlowLane

--
[Attachment: traffic_snapshot_q2.csv (CSV)]

From: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
To: Elena Castro <elena@flowlane.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: GrowthLane hosted API expansion — initial ask

Elena — really appreciate the context and congrats on the product lift. Quick summary and next steps below.

Summary proposal (high level)
- Baseline commit: 20M tokens/month (12-month term)
- Burst pocket: additional 10M tokens/month at negotiated overage rates; soft throttles before hard rate-limits
- Rate tiers: up to commit priced at $0.0026/token; overage band between 20M-30M at $0.0031/token; falling back to pay-as-you-go beyond 30M
- Throughput: recommended 400 qps sustained per model route, we can scale dedicated lanes if you need >1k qps

Operational items I attached below: SOW draft, pricing schedule, and a one-pager on data retention (we keep model request logs for 30 days by default; customer-managed retention available on Private).

Next steps
1) Vanessa to confirm commercial terms and rebate structure for annualization (cc'd).
2) FlowLane to confirm expected traffic distribution (model routes / peak qps) so we can size dedicated lanes or suggest routing policies.
3) Kimberly to draft a short data-retention addendum for your security team.

I attached a draft SOW. Happy to jump on a call tomorrow with Vanessa and Kim to lock down numbers.

Thanks —
Dylan
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOW_GrowthLane_v2.pdf (PDF)]

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Elena Castro <elena@flowlane.com>, dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Hosted commit — commercial options and incentive proposal

Hi Elena — looping in a couple folks to get commercial, legal, and post-sale alignment. Nice to e-meet.

Two optional commercial paths we can offer for FlowLane:
A) Annualized commit (preferred)
  - 20M tokens/mo committed over 12 months (paid monthly)
  - $0.0025/token for committed volume (tiered discount applied at contract signature if annual prepay)
  - One-time onboarding credit of $10k applied to first invoice for migration/testing
B) Staged onramp (if you prefer to start smaller + scale)
  - 12M tokens/mo for first 3 months at $0.0027/token, then step to 20M/mo for the remainder at $0.0026/token

Rate-limit and throughput guardrails
- Soft throttle at 95% of sustained qps during rolling windows (we communicate via 429s with retry-after header)
- Priority lanes for critical routes when you adopt dedicated capacity (Grace to outline capacity sizing)

If you confirm path A today, we can issue an updated SOW and send a DocuSign for signature within 24 business hours.

Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pricing_schedule_q3_2028.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@flowlane.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, dylan_brooks@redwood.ai, Elena Castro <elena@flowlane.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 11:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted commit — commercial options and incentive proposal

Thanks — Vanessa. A few questions from procurement/legal: 1) Can you confirm invoice cadence (monthly vs. quarterly)? 2) Any committed minimum billing if we underutilize in a month? 3) We need a short SLA clause for token latency 99th pct (our SREs will want a target).

Also, security asked about keys and rotation — do you support per-service API keys and KMS integration for secrets?

Marcus
VP Product Ops, FlowLane

On Tue, Jun 12, 2028 at 08:27 AM vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai wrote:
> Hi Elena — looping in a couple folks to get commercial, legal, and post-sale alignment.

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@flowlane.com>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 13 Jun 2028 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted commit — commercial options and incentive proposal

Marcus / Elena — quick answers for procurement and security items below: 
- Invoice cadence: Monthly invoices by default; quarterly billing available with a small admin surcharge (we can list in SOW).
- Commit billing: If you underutilize, you are billed against the committed quantity (we invoice the committed tokens each month per contract). We can include a one-time quarterly consumption true-up at renewal for very large variance (example clause in SOW).
- SLA/latency: We can commit to 99th percentile inference latency target for standard routes at <= 250ms for sequences <=512 tokens on the hosted plan; dedicated capacity offers stricter latency SLAs. We will add the exact metric language to the SOW.
- Keys/KMS: We support per-service API keys, rotation, and customers can integrate with their KMS for storage of secrets in Private deployments. For hosted, Redwood manages keys but supports HSM-backed customer-managed keys for enterprise.

I'll add these bullets to the SOW and re-issue for signature.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Castro <elena@flowlane.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@flowlane.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 10:56:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted commit — commercial options and incentive proposal

Appreciate the clarity — we're leaning toward Path A (annualized commit). Two final asks before we sign:
1) Can you add an emergency burst buffer that FlowLane can consume up to 15M tokens in a single month without immediate overage billing (we'd pay at overage rates but avoid hard throttles)?
2) We need an Ops readiness checklist for our launch on July 10th: staging keys, traffic-shaping guidance, and a runbook for fallback to pay-as-you-go routes.

If you can incorporate the burst buffer and the ops checklist in the SOW today, we can route for exec approval and sign.

Best,
Elena

> On Wed, Jun 13, 2028 at 09:20 AM kimberly_park@redwood.ai wrote:
> > Marcus / Elena — quick answers for procurement and security items below:

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Elena Castro <elena@flowlane.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Hosted commit — commercial options and incentive proposal

Elena — we can accommodate both asks. Updated commitments: 
- Emergency burst buffer: FlowLane will have a 15M-token emergency buffer available once per quarter; consumption billed at overage rate $0.0031/token and capped with an executive review if usage exceeds the buffer. No hard throttles during the buffer window.
- Ops readiness checklist: Grace has drafted the checklist (staging keys, recommended client-side rate-limits, routes to label as critical, and fallback playbook). I'll attach the updated SOW and the ops checklist; if you approve, we will send DocuSign tonight.

Working assumptions to confirm before signature: start date 2028-07-01, monthly invoicing, 12-month term, 20M committed tokens/month.

Thanks — Vanessa
